parts.text: $PAGP: sold more but kept less — revenue +31% to $15.2B, but operating margin shrank to 3.4%. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$EGTS: operating profit grew faster than sales, +21% vs +7%. Q3 2026 revenue reached $7.7B with a 23.3% operating margin. 👇 #earnings #utilities
$BRK-B: revenue grew 11% to $105.6B, but operating profit fell 10% as costs outpaced sales growth. 👇 #earnings #insurance
$NRG: operating profit grew faster than sales, +162% vs +24%. Q3 (preliminary) revenue reached $9.5B with an 11.5% margin. 👇 #earnings #utilities
$DOLE: profit is growing faster than sales — operating profit +268% to $0.09B on revenue +4% to $2.4B in Q3. 👇 #earnings #consumer
$SGI: sold more but kept less — revenue +11% to $2.4B, while net earnings fell 8% to $164M (preliminary). Q3 2026 costs rose on acquisition activity. 👇 #earnings #consumer
$BNSF: cash came in ahead of profit — operating cash flow $2.4B, 142% of net earnings. Q3 revenue $6.9B (+15% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #industrials
$BAM: about 57¢ of every revenue dollar is operating profit. Q3 revenue $2.1B (+72% Y/Y). 👇 #earnings #finance
$RBA: operating profit grew faster than sales, +37% vs +17% revenue growth in Q3. Total revenue reached $1.3B. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$CNH: cash ran far ahead of profit — operating cash flow reached $686M on net earnings of $30M. Q3 revenue flat at $4.4B. 👇 #earnings #industrials
$RF: about 40¢ of every revenue dollar is operating profit, up from 37¢ a year ago. Q3 revenue $2.0B (+3% Y/Y), net earnings $631M. 👇 #earnings #banks
